entities.summary: Tim Rogers (b. 1969-09-20, Kalgoorlie) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kalgoorlie and Australia. Known in the fields of australia, composers & musicians, oceania.
